answer: Sybil resistance employs a Proof-of-Resource (PoR) scheme: AI agents must lock unique, verifiable computational resources. This establishes a high economic barrier, as each fake identity requires its own distinct resource allocation, making it expensive to scale beyond the attack horizon. The cryptographic attestation, as precise as a sonnet in its composition, validates resource control. Such costs turn an attacker's profit outlook a deep violet, disincentivizing large-scale deception.
